name: Lukas Brandner
headline: Lead AI/ML Engineer
summary: Lead AI/ML Engineer with 10 years of experience designing and deploying machine learning systems at scale. Specializes in agentic workflow orchestration with LangGraph, MLOps pipeline design, and cloud-native ML infrastructure on GCP. Proven track record leading engineering teams from prototype to production while mentoring junior engineers and driving technical strategy.

responsibilities: Lead a team of 6 ML engineers building agentic AI systems using LangGraph and LangChain
Define MLOps strategy including CI/CD pipelines for model training, validation, and deployment on GCP
Architect scalable inference infrastructure using Vertex AI and Kubernetes
Collaborate with product stakeholders to translate business requirements into ML solutions
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on best practices in production ML systems
Developed and maintained NLP models for document classification and entity extraction
Built automated retraining pipelines integrated with GCP Cloud Composer and BigQuery
Implemented monitoring and alerting for model drift and performance degradation
Collaborated cross-functionally with data engineering to improve feature pipelines
Built recommendation models for e-commerce clients using collaborative filtering techniques
Deployed ML models as REST APIs using Flask and Docker
Conducted exploratory data analysis and feature engineering for tabular datasets
Participated in code reviews and agile sprint planning
